title: Payroll with base reuse
prompt: Implement nested classes in `Solution`: abstract `Employee` with protected `Name`, public constructor validating non-blank name (else `ArgumentException`), read-only `Name`, `public abstract decimal MonthlyPay();`; `Salaried(decimal monthly)` overriding `MonthlyPay()` to return the salary; `Hourly(decimal rate, int hours)` overriding to return `rate * hours`.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Both subclasses compute differently but expose the same MonthlyPay contract.

tests.name: validation
tests.hint: The name invariant lives once in the base — both subclasses inherit it.
